original.statement: The default logging format is switched to JSON.

decision.reason: [ev-bacdc0376810] only says "Switch default logging to JSON". The old default is implied but never stated as a literal, so default-changed (which needs a stated "before" value) is not supported, and behavior-changed with after "JSON" is the closest type the evidence backs. The subject name "default-logging-json" uses only the evidence's own words. Because the evidence names no log-format flag, env var or config key, protocol-behavior is the closest family available, though it is an imperfect fit.
